provenance.canonical_layout: SEC XBRL company-concept payloads captured verbatim from data.sec.gov for the revenue, operating income and depreciation concepts, plus the canonical price series and acceptance evidence reused by path from data/historical_pe/AAPL. Each concept file is the byte-exact companyconcept API response; its sha256 pins what the reconstruction read.

concept_fetch.transport: HTTPS GET data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000320193/{taxonomy}/{tag}.json with a declared contactable User-Agent, honouring the SEC fair-access policy
concept_fetch.response_units: verbatim as returned: USD for all three concepts

revenue_concept.json.definition: The filer's own contract-revenue line, the element the registry maps EXACTLY to the revenue metric from 2017-09-30. The 10-Q states the three-month and the year-to-date duration, so the discrete quarters are directly stated except the fourth, which is the fiscal year less the nine months.

operating_income_concept.json.definition: Operating activities before interest, taxes and non-operating items, as presented. The registry maps the element EXACTLY to the operating income metric. Same period structure as the revenue line: the three-month quarter is stated, the fourth is the fiscal year less the nine months.

depreciation_concept.json.definition: Apple's combined 'Depreciation and amortization' cash-flow line. The element's own definition also covers depleting assets, so the registry maps it to the metric for Apple alone and not as a market-wide EXACT mapping. It is a cash-flow line, so every quarter but the first is a cumulative difference.

daily_prices.json (reused by path).source: The canonical historical P/E dataset's price series, read by path. The trading calendar decides when a filing's fact becomes knowable under the 16:00 ET cutoff rule, so one calendar serves every reconstruction.

filing_acceptance_evidence.json (reused.source: The canonical historical P/E dataset's acceptance index: each filing's acceptance datetime, form and period end. A fact whose filing is not in the index has no knowability evidence in this dataset and is skipped.

semantic_qualification.policy: A source element is qualified for a metric only when the core registry resolves it to that metric for that filer: an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, in force at the date read, whose scope covers the filer. An element the registry declines, retires, maps only partially, maps to another metric or scopes to another filer is not qualified, and its filed values produce no figure and no production reference. Holding a filed element as traceable evidence is not the same as admitting it to a valuation.
semantic_qualification.read_by: the core registry, as seeded from registry_seed
semantic_qualification.subject: AAPL income dataset

revenue.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax to 'revenue' for AAPL as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, without a filer restriction, in force from 2017-09-30. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.

operating_income.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss to 'operating_income' for AAPL as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, without a filer restriction. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.

depreciation_and_amortization.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization to 'depreciation_and_amortization' for AAPL as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, scoped to AAPL. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.
